item.title: ❗️ Today in the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out strikes
item.description: ❗️ Today , in the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres as well as port and railway infrastructure facilities involved in supporting the AFU. As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: 📍 in the port of Nikolayev , infrastructure facilities intended for the storage of fuel and lubricants to support the AFU; 📍 a warehouse in Novy Petrovtsy of Kiev region , used for storing unmanned aerial vehicles and components for them; 📍 a railway locomotive near the Dnepropetrovsk railway station , used for transporting cargo intended to support the AFU. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Rushing like Typhoon: how storming soldiers of Tsentr Group of Forces took Shilovka
item.description: Rushing like Typhoon: how storming soldiers of Tsentr Group of Forces took Shilovka ▫️ The enemy turned the village into a real fortress. They dug up deep ditches, encircled the approaches with barbed wire, and planted mines. But even such serious defence could not stop the Typhoon detachment. ▫️ Russian servicemen have examined all the approaches to Shilovka in detail and have previously calculated the routes for any situation whether it is foggy, daylight, or twilight. 👊 As the assault detachments entered the village and started a close-quarters combat, the AFU defence immediately collapsed. 'If a mess begins, mercenaries mostly try to escape, leave AFU troops to engage in fire fight. But it doesn't always work out. The sky is under control. Russian FPV drones are flying in and artillery is producing fire,' said platoon commander Ivan Klimovskikh. ▫️ Russian servicemen took Shilovka, levelled the front, and formed a reliable bridgehead for a further offensive. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30632

❗️
The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation
. In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Muravskoye, Podsredneye, Ploskoye, Novoselovka, and Shipovatoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region
, formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Yastrebinoye, Stetskovka, Vakalovshchina, Nikolayevka, Golubovka, and Bititsa (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 195 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 13 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades have been engaged near Studenok, Proletarskoye, Malinovka, Monachinovka, Nechvolodovka (Kharkov region), Rubtsy, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Formations of three mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine were hit near Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Orekhovatka, and Kramatorsk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 30 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations
. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two marine brigades, and two national guard brigades near Novosergeyevka, Krivorozhye, Kuritsyno, Sergeyevka, Lvovka, Novopavlovka, and Yakovlevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 330 troops, one tank, two armoured fighting vehicles, and six motor vehicles.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
